name: When should I hire a general contractor instead of managing a project myself?

mainEntity.name: When should I hire a general contractor instead of managing a project myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider hiring a general contractor when your project involves multiple trades (e.g., plumbing, electrical, carpentry), requires permits, or has a complex scope. Managing such projects yourself can be time-consuming and challenging without industry knowledge and established subcontractor relationships. A general contractor, like City Dweller, LLC, brings expertise in scheduling, quality control, and problem-solving, which can save you time, stress, and potentially money in the long run by avoiding costly mistakes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hire a general contractor for complex projects involving multiple trades, permits, or when you lack the time and expertise to manage it yourself. They bring efficiency and experience to avoid common pitfalls.
